name: Dimension Bounds for Cornerless Ample Classes
statement: If a nonempty cornerless ample class has VC dimension $d$ and $n$ active coordinates, then $3\le d\le n-1$. If it is maximum, then $3\le d\le n-2$.
proof: Ample classes of VC dimension at most two are corner peelable and therefore have a corner. At $d=n$, ampleness forces the full cube, whose vertices are corners. A maximum class with $d=n-1$ has $2^n-1$ vertices and is a cube with one vertex deleted; its corners are the neighbours of the missing vertex.
